args.text:
Batch of 8 runs, all 8 accepted, all reported with the width-free ratio (plane sections not run). 5 flagged, 3 cleared.
- Flagged, summary_outlier: r01 and r06. The largest flank difference is at 284 µm, but at 1074 µm in every other run. The growth zone is also a little shorter (684 vs 695 µm). So the strain-rate profile has a different shape.
- Flagged, width_free_ratio_used: r04, r05 and r08. The width-free ratio maximum is +0.074, against a batch median of -0.019 (z 4.18), so the sign is reversed. In r04 the maximum is 50 µm from the tip, against 800 µm in r02. That points to a tip artefact. The position was only checked in r04's record; r05 and r08 have the same summaries.
- Cleared: r02, r03 and r07. Rigid invariance and closure pass, and every summary is within |z| 0.67 of the batch.
In common: every flagged run passed rigid invariance and closure. All five were flagged for an unusual curvature-rate or width-free profile (where the flank difference or ratio maximum sits along the root), not for a failed check. The centre REGR peak (about 53 %/h at 421 µm) matches across the whole batch.
